def fetch_notes(query, page_limit=20, max_pages=20):
    alln=[]
    for page in range(max_pages):
        r=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=token_simple, query=query, page_index=page, page_limit=page_limit)
        notes=r if isinstance(r,list) else r.get('notes',[]) if isinstance(r,dict) else []
        if not notes:
            break
        alln.extend(notes)
    return alln

for q in ['workout', 'playlist', 'spotify', 'music', 'gym']:
    ns=fetch_notes(q)
    print('query',q,'count',len(ns))
    print([(n.get('note_id'), n.get('title')) for n in ns])
    print('---')
